# pvecli cluster firewall

Manage the firewall of the datacenter.

## status

Show the firewall of every level of the cluster, and what is not enforced.

```text
pvecli cluster firewall status [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## rule

Firewall rules of the datacenter

```text
pvecli cluster firewall rule
```

## options

Show the firewall options, with the defaults Proxmox applies.

```text
pvecli cluster firewall options [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## group

Security groups: named lists of rules

```text
pvecli cluster firewall group
```

## ipset

IP sets of the datacenter

```text
pvecli cluster firewall ipset
```

## alias

Aliases of the datacenter

```text
pvecli cluster firewall alias
```

## macros

List the macros a rule can use (SSH, HTTPS, Ceph...).

```text
pvecli cluster firewall macros [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## refs

List the aliases and IP sets a rule can name as source or destination.

```text
pvecli cluster firewall refs [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## export

Export the whole firewall of the cluster (YAML, or JSON with --json).

```text
pvecli cluster firewall export [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-ou`, `--output VALUE` | Write to this file instead of the terminal. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |
